core.title: The Common Denominator
core.label: Hypothalamic dysfunction
core.why: Your hypothalamus coordinates hormones, sleep, temperature, stress and immunity. When it is under strain, one root can show up in many places at once.

domains.plain: When your body clock is off, sleep doesn’t refresh you and your energy runs low.
domains.title: Circadian & Mitochondrial Dysfunction

domains.plain: When your hormone signals are off, you can feel wired but tired, hot or cold, and your cycle can change.
domains.title: Neuroendocrine Signaling

domains.plain: When your immune system is overactive, joints ache, skin flares and you feel worn out.
domains.title: Autoimmunity

domains.plain: When your brain is under strain, focus slips, memory fades and your mood can dip.
domains.title: Neurodivergence, Mood & Memory

domains.plain: When your body repairs more slowly, you lose strength, recover slowly and skin and bones thin.
domains.title: Premature Aging

domains.plain: When your nerves stay on high alert, pain spreads, headaches come more often and sleep suffers.
domains.title: Chronic Pain

domains.plain: When your body’s automatic controls are off, your heart can race, you feel dizzy, sweat more or your gut slows.
domains.title: Dysautonomia

domains.plain: When your body struggles with sugar and fat, weight is hard to shift and blood sugar and pressure creep up.
domains.title: Metabolic Syndromes
